requirements.text: The RLCS application shall provide a Graphical User Interface (GUI) for system status monitoring, command issuance, system configuration, and report generation.
The system shall implement a secure logon process requiring username and password, with access control based on user security levels.
The system shall monitor all field device sensors and report status changes on the GUI within 2 seconds.
The system shall execute stored operational control command sequences based on the current system mode and schedule.
The system shall validate all control commands against safety rules stored in non-volatile memory before execution.
The system shall generate and store logs for device commands, system operations, alarms, and operator activities.
The system shall provide a one-way data output to an external server every 60 seconds for use by external systems like ATMS-2 and FasTrak.
The system shall support remote access for authorized users through a firewall via a secure dial-up connection.
The system shall use a one-way hash function (MD5 or equivalent) to ensure the integrity of application data and software in controllers.
All user passwords and device rules shall be stored in an encrypted format.
The system shall be available 24/7 with a minimum uptime of 99.99%.
The system shall detect and report critical alarm conditions within 2 seconds of occurrence.
Field devices shall respond to commands within 12 seconds of operator confirmation.
The system architecture shall be modular and scalable to support at least two additional DCU controllers and associated field devices without requiring software reprogramming.
The system shall function in a degraded mode, allowing manual or alternate control if primary TMC workstations or network components fail.
The GUI shall allow for facility map modifications and device additions without requiring programming effort.
